measures.name: Premium
measures.definition: Premium charged for the cover, excluding taxes and fees.

measures.name: Premium tax
measures.definition: Tax levied on premium (e.g. GST, IPT), as charged to the policyholder.

measures.name: Fee
measures.definition: Policy, installment or service fee charged in addition to premium.

measures.name: Invoiced amount
measures.definition: Amount billed on one invoice; becomes an invoice receivable.

measures.name: Payment amount
measures.definition: Cash received in one payment (receipt), before allocation.

measures.name: Allocated amount
measures.definition: Part of a payment applied to one invoice.

measures.name: Write-off amount
measures.definition: Receivable written off as uncollectable or below threshold, as reported by the source.

measures.name: Commission
measures.definition: Commission payable to the distributor on premium.

measures.name: Claim reserve movement
measures.definition: Change in the case reserve held for a claim.

measures.name: Earned premium
measures.definition: Premium earned over the period, as computed by the earnings system.
